text: When I stopped the machine at last. <break time="0.8s" /> I found myself sitting. <break time="0.8s" /> On soft grass in a little garden. <break time="0.8s" /> In the middle of a heavy hailstorm. <break time="0.8s" /> The dials on the machine. <break time="0.8s" /> Told me an astonishing fact. <break time="0.8s" /> That I had arrived. <break time="0.8s" /> In the year 802, 701. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the gray curtain of hail. <break time="0.8s" /> I saw a huge white figure. <break time="0.8s" /> Which looked like a sphinx. <break time="0.8s" /> With its wings spread wide. <break time="0.8s" /> It stood on a bronze pedestal. <break time="0.8s" /> And its face. <break time="0.8s" /> Which was turned toward me. <break time="0.8s" /> Seemed to wear. <break time="0.8s" /> A faint and unpleasant smile. <break time="0.8s" /> As the hail grew thinner. <break time="0.8s" /> I saw great buildings. <break time="0.8s" /> Rising among the trees. <break time="0.8s" /> And a sudden fear. <break time="0.8s" /> Took hold of me. <break time="0.8s" /> What if the people of this age. <break time="0.8s" /> Had become cruel and powerful. <break time="0.8s" /> And treated me. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a wild animal from the past. <break time="0.8s" /> In a panic. <break time="0.8s" /> I tried to set the machine upright again. <break time="0.8s" /> Ready to escape. <break time="0.8s" /> When I saw figures. <break time="0.8s" /> Coming out of a nearby building. <break time="0.8s" /> Never had I felt. <break time="0.8s" /> So helpless and alone. <break time="0.8s" /> As I did at that moment. <break time="0.8s" /> In that strange new world.
